newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Parent mulls sale of Sun Fook Kong stake.
newsitem.headline: Parent mulls sale of Sun Fook Kong stake.

text.p: Shares of Sun Fook Kong Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its 51.6 percent controlling shareholders were in talks on the sale of part of their stake in the company, which might lead to a general offer.

"They are currently involved in discussions with an independent third party which may lead to a disposal of some of their shareholding in the company and a general offer for the remaining shares of the company," it said in a statement.
"The discussions may also lead to proposals whereby connected persons of the company would acquire part of the company's business," Sun Fook Kong said.

The construction and civil engineering group said the discussions were at a preliminary stage and no agreement had yet been reached, and it was an uncertainty of what would be the effects if the deal took place.
Sun Fook Kong shares were up HK$0.33 or 32.67 percent to HK$1.34 in late morning after hitting an all time high of HK$1.37. Volume was 124.5 million shares worth HK$150.75 million.
